Natural-month grids describe structure without choosing a graphics system.
Signatures include the month layout and week-start convention. A year
signature is the ordered set of its twelve month signatures.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(jwcalendarR)
```

```{r}
calendar_grid(2027, 1, week_start = 1)
calendar_equivalent(2015, 2026)
calendar_cycle_summary()
```

The Gregorian leap-year and weekday pattern repeats every 400 years. Year
equivalence here means identical month layouts under the selected week-start
rule, not historical, holiday, fiscal, or jurisdictional equivalence.
